title: Stack MCP server declarations
description: Which MCP servers a stack wants, and how to launch the ones ai-badger may launch. Read at scaffold time and NOT indexed, the same contract as skills.json; the servers themselves are catalog items under features/<stack>/mcp/<name>/. Naming a server here is a 'this is relevant' claim that holds for every arrival route; 'declare' is the louder claim that ai-badger should write its launch config, and only two routes accept one (ADR-0014).

name.description: The server's merge key. Must name a features/<stack>/mcp/<name>/ catalog entry.

command.description: Launch command, e.g. 'python3 -m code_review_graph serve'. Split on whitespace into command + args. Required when 'declare' is true and pointless without it: a server ai-badger cannot launch is described, not declared.

declare.description: Write this server's launch config into the project files ai-badger owns (.mcp.json and .github/mcp.json). Defaults to false: describing a server is the common case, declaring one is the exception.

scope.description: project = repo-level config ai-badger owns. user = a user-global file, which ai-badger proposes and never writes (ADR-0014 decision 6).

env.description: Environment variables the launch config carries. Values are literals or ${VAR} references — never a secret.

command.description: Executable that must resolve on PATH before this optional declaration is emitted.

availability.description: Optional host capability gate. When present, the declaration is emitted only if the command resolves on PATH.

agentOverrides.description: Per-agent launch overrides, applied by the one agent that reads each generated file.
